Brown.FogDensityHelp: How thick the brown mist is.
Brown.SmoothSpeedHelp: How fast the mist fades in/out.
Brown.UnstableThresholdHelp: Brown mist triggers when stability is below this threshold. Default: 1.0.
Brown.UnstableFinishThresholdHelp: Hard cap. If stability goes below this value, brown mist intensity will NOT increase further.

Teal.FogDensityHelp: How thick the teal mist is.
Teal.SmoothSpeedHelp: How fast the mist fades in/out.
Teal.StableThresholdHelp: Teal mist triggers when stability is above this threshold. Default: 1.30.
Teal.StableFinishThresholdHelp: Hard cap. If stability goes above this value, teal mist intensity will NOT increase further.
